system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you would hit an allied creature (excluding yourself) with an attack, you may spend a reaction and 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you create a ghostly web of chakra that tries to destabilize the attack. Reduce the attack roll result by an amount equal to the result of the Superiority Die.
